name: Hello, My Name Is
source:
"Hello, My Name Is" is a visual novel featuring interactions between the employee of a convenience store and its patrons.

[From [url=https://willdesign.itch.io/hellomynameis] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《你好，我的名字是》是一部视觉小说，讲述便利店员工与顾客之间的互动。

（来源：[url=https://willdesign.itch.io/hellomynameis]itch.io[/url]）
